## Verified sheet remembered-state subset — related UI batch, 2026-10-29

Both original UI-019 criteria pass in actual public UIKit/Compose tests:
- A visible sheet retains state/controller identity and current/targetPartiallyExpanded while callback captures and density change. The current policy vetoes hide without calling the old callback; a new current policy then permits actual native hide/Hidden state.
- A real SaveableStateRegistry saves/restores the visible sheet into a new real root. Live density changes retain identity. Deliberate structural skipPartiallyExpanded reset replaces only the old owner, detaches its manager/Hidden state/controller, and installs an actual large-only/Expanded sheet.

[40854890326](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40854890326) at `58b533547a544d00c773882f6935c23a3a25f85a`: **2/2 sheet methods +4/4 genuine application-host methods pass**, three fresh XML, 862 exact historical Git-bound inputs. Actual native protocol/KGP XML, Worker completion, binary/runtime-before/after and owned installation/cleanup agree. The **whole run remains FAILED (7pass/1fail, Gradleexit1/1570.15s)**: a separate time-test epoch witness fails before its locale/zone/state-replacement checks. #124 stays open for focused recovery; its failure does not delay this verified sheet subset.

Owning repair uses stable rememberUpdatedState confirmation/density holders and only deliberate structural rememberSaveable reset keys. Public signatures/packages/Saver contract retained. iOS does not use Material numerical drag thresholds; these tests are not native gestures, Android process-death, heap/weak-reference, physical/minimum-platform, complete ABI/consumer, dependency/legal/security or release certification. UI-018 and other independent gates remain open. No packages/releases/deployments/Pages.

Closing directly after important shared-result/original-criteria review, without rerunning the successful host/sheet methods or waiting for the unrelated time recovery. Additive evidence/readbacks follow in `docs/development/evidence/ui-state-batch-important-20261029/native-ci001/`. Upstream#116/#119 and original issue body/title/labels/history remain preserved.
